name: Air quality (CAMS global and European models)

measures.definition: Fine particles under 2.5 micrometres, modelled: the mean concentration over the last full year at the city's coordinates.

rights.edition: Open-Meteo air-quality API (CAMS global and European), fetched on demand
rights.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com/), CC BY 4.0
notices: Contains modified Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information. Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for any use that may be made of the Copernicus information or data it contains.

vetted.notes: Covers every place; used where WHO's measured figure cannot be fetched (the browser) or does not exist.

caveats: A model, not a measurement: it can miss local sources such as a busy valley or wood stoves. Measured WHO figures win where both exist.
